Endo and Chiesa excluded from Liverpool's Champions League squad

Liverpool has excluded midfielders Wataru Endo and Federico Chiesa from their UEFA Champions League squad. The specific reasons for their exclusion were not detailed in the coverage. Both players were notably absent from the team's roster for the upcoming competition.
